dashboard.title: System Status
dashboard.subtitle: Global concurrency monitoring and Qwen account pool overview.

accounts.subtitle: Manage upstream account pool, distinguishing between pending, rate-limited, banned, and invalid states.

manual.desc: If you are already logged in to chat.qwen.ai, you can manually inject your token into the pool.

tokens.title: API Key Management
tokens.subtitle: Manage downstream credentials that can access this gateway.

settings.title: System Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage console authentication and gateway runtime configuration.

session.title: Current Session Key
session.desc: Paste your existing API Key here. The console will use it for all administrative actions (stored locally in browser).

core.title: Core Parameters
core.desc: Runtime concurrency slots and queue thresholds (requires restart if modified in backend config.json).
core.inflight_desc: Controls the number of simultaneous requests per upstream account to avoid bans.

modes.thinking_desc: Enables deep logic and 'Chain of Thought' reasoning. The system will be smarter but with higher latency (slower).
modes.search_desc: Allows the model to perform real-time web searches to provide up-to-date information.

aliases.title: Model Aliases (Mapping)
aliases.desc: Incoming model names will be automatically routed to these Qwen models. Edit using standard JSON format.

test.subtitle: Test your API distribution here to ensure it works correctly.
